g.text: Physical footprint held approximately constant; logical N decreases as stride grows. Useful bytes count touched elements, not full cache lines.
Not measured DRAM-controller bandwidth. Median/range of 3 process medians. AVX2 gather plus scalar scatter for strided outputs.
